explanation.description: A detailed explanation supporting the finding.
explanation.title: Finding Explanation

summary.description: Summary of the key insight about the community.
summary.title: Finding Summary

detailed_findings.description: A list of 5-10 key insights about the community. Each insight should have a short summary followed by multiple paragraphs of explanatory text grounded according to the grounding rules below. Be comprehensive.
detailed_findings.title: Detailed Findings

impact_severity_rating.description: a float score between 0-10 that represents the severity of IMPACT posed by entities within the community.  IMPACT is the scored importance of a community.
impact_severity_rating.title: Impact Severity Rating

rating_explanation.description: Give a single sentence explanation of the IMPACT severity rating.
rating_explanation.title: Rating Explanation

summary.description: An executive summary of the community's overall structure, how its entities are related to each other, and significant information associated with its entities.
summary.title: Summary

title.description: community's name that represents its key entities - title should be short but specific. When possible, include representative named entities in the title.
title.title: Title
